site_acres.label: Site area, acres (hypothetical parcel)
site_acres.assumption: About two acres. The village code's filling station standards need at least 12,000 sq ft and 100 ft of frontage, two driveways and full setbacks [^14]; two acres holds the store, four dispensers, parking and screening with room to spare. The parcel, its route and its business district are hypothetical and are conditions to confirm.

land_per_acre.label: Land allowance per acre
land_per_acre.assumption: An allowance, not a price found for any parcel. The research holds no vacant commercial land sale for the village; the one recorded nearby commercial sale, an improved 0.32-acre Main Street property sold on February 7, 2019 [^17], prices a building rather than raw land. The study sets $75,000 an acre for land in a small farming-county village and makes the appraisal the source of the real figure; land is a small share of the project, so the loan is not sensitive to it.

store_sf.label: Store size, square feet
store_sf.assumption: Matches the 3,000 sq ft example in a contractor's 2026 cost guide [^38] and stays under the average size of Yesway's older stores [^36]; a village of 2,715 people does not need more.

building_psf.label: Building with canopy, cost per store square foot
building_psf.assumption: Slightly above the middle of the per-square-foot band a 2026 contractor guide gives for a store with its canopy [^38]; building inputs cost 7.1% more in June 2026 than a year before [^40].

tanks.label: Underground storage tanks
tanks.assumption: Regular, premium and diesel; Casey's on Main Street also sells E85 and an 88-octane blend from its tanks [^20].

tank_cost.label: Installed cost per tank, complete
tank_cost.assumption: Middle of the vendor's band for a finished installation, which its August 2026 update puts between $60,000 and $380,000 a tank [^39]; tanks must also meet the federal UST rules the village code cites [^14].

dispensers.label: Dispensers (8 fueling positions)
dispensers.assumption: The contractor example's 4 dispensers [^38]; the village code requires at least two driveways 20 ft apart, which a 2-acre lot meets [^14].

dispenser_cost.label: Cost per dispenser
dispenser_cost.assumption: Mid-range of what the same vendor's table shows per dispenser [^39].

sitework.label: Site work, paving, screening, canopy lighting and signage
sitework.assumption: Allowance; the code's filling station section sets recessed canopy lights, a 6-ft screen next to residential districts and one pole sign [^14]. Village tap and connection fees were not found.

contingency_pct.label: Construction contingency
contingency_pct.assumption: A 5% reserve on store, tanks and site work for a job not yet bid.

soft.label: Design, conditional use permit, development plan, Phase I and legal
soft.assumption: Allowance for design, the conditional use and development plan filings the village requires for a filling station [^14], and the Phase I report a fuel-site lender expects in every file [^42].

ffe.label: Fixtures, coolers, pizza and breakfast kitchen, point of sale
ffe.assumption: Allowance for a store that competes with Casey's made-to-order pizza [^18].

fuel_inventory.label: Opening fuel inventory
fuel_inventory.assumption: The bottom of the opening fuel band in Holiday's 2025 franchise disclosure, which a contractor reports as $100,000 to $300,000 [^41]; four dispensers hold and turn less fuel.

merch_inventory.label: Opening merchandise and food inventory
merch_inventory.assumption: Allowance sized to a 3,000 sq ft store with a pizza line.

working_capital.label: Opening payroll, training and cash cushion
working_capital.assumption: About two months of modelled payroll and fixed costs.

gallons_day.label: Fuel gallons sold per day
gallons_day.assumption: Reaches a little over half of the roughly 4,000 gallons NACS gives as a typical store's daily volume [^32]: three stations already serve a village of 2,715 [^1] and its township, and no traffic count for any of the village's state routes was found.

fuel_margin.label: Fuel gross margin per gallon
fuel_margin.assumption: Close to the 39.7-cent national gasoline margin for 2024 [^32] and well under the 47.8 cents Casey's earned in its quarter to July 31, 2026, a quarter inflated by that year's supply disruption [^37]. Ohio's fuel tax holiday changes the pump price, not this margin, because the state requires retailers to pass the whole tax saving to customers [^25].

inside_sales.label: Inside sales, merchandise and food
inside_sales.assumption: Short of the $1.7 million inside total of an older Yesway store, a format built for towns like this one [^36]; Midmark, which says its headquarters and largest plant are in Versailles [^7], supplies the breakfast and lunch trade.

food_margin.label: Foodservice gross margin
food_margin.assumption: A few points under the 58.3% Casey's made on prepared food through the third quarter of fiscal 2026 [^35].

merch_margin.label: Merchandise gross margin
merch_margin.assumption: Packaged goods alone, so under the 35.2% Yesway reported for its whole inside store in 2025 [^36].

staff_shift.label: Staff on the floor per hour
staff_shift.assumption: Under Yesway's 2.6 per shift [^36]; a pizza oven needs a second person through the day.

hours.label: Hours open per day
hours.assumption: 5 a.m. to 10 p.m., the hours Casey's keeps on Main Street [^18].

burden.label: Payroll taxes and benefits
burden.assumption: Ohio employer payroll taxes, workers' compensation and basic benefits; no Darke County figure was in the research.

inflation.label: Annual growth in wages and fixed costs
inflation.assumption: Set near consumer price growth of 3.4% in the year to August 2026 [^37].

utilities.label: Village electric, water and sewer, and gas, Year 1
utilities.assumption: Allowance; neither the providers serving the parcel nor a tariff was retrieved, so service, tap fees and rates are a lender condition.

repairs.label: Repairs, supplies and tank compliance, Year 1
repairs.assumption: Allowance; includes the periodic tank and line tests a lender's environmental file tracks [^42].

insurance.label: Property, liability and pollution insurance, Year 1
insurance.assumption: Allowance for an inland store; the FEMA flood zone was not found, so a quote is a lender condition.

admin.label: Accounting, licenses and permits, Year 1
admin.assumption: Allowance; Ohio's license list and fees (fuel, tobacco, lottery, liquor permits) were not found in the research.

eff_mills.label: Effective commercial tax rate, mills per dollar of assessed value

assess_ratio.label: Ohio assessed value, share of market value
assess_ratio.assumption: Ohio assesses real property at 35% of market value; the County Auditors' Association states the rule but its page carries no date [^29], so the study treats it as an assumption and makes the Darke County Auditor's valuation a lender condition.

reserve_pct.label: Equipment renewal reserve, percent of dispenser and fixture cost a year
reserve_pct.assumption: Builds a fund to renew dispensers, coolers and ovens over about twenty years.

uses.label: Site work, screening, lighting and signage
Design, conditional use, Phase I and legal
Fixtures, coolers, kitchen and point of sale

revenue.label: Fuel gross profit
revenue.basis: daily gallons x 365 x cents of margin [^32,37]

revenue.label: Pizza and prepared food gross profit

opex.label: Payroll with employer costs
opex.expr: staff_shift * hours * 365 * wage * (1 + burden) * (1 + inflation) ** y

opex.label: Real property tax
opex.expr: (site_acres * land_per_acre + store_sf * building_psf + tanks * tank_cost + sitework) * assess_ratio * eff_mills
